findings.title: Five guarded Enterprise module runs have coherent test method counts

evidence.excerpt_or_summary: Five scoped log/receipt pairs report 47+66+68+27+23=231 successful test invocations, method start counts match each receipt; the same methods repeat across lanes, so this is not 231 unique behaviors.

findings.impact: Narrow Enterprise module-test evidence is credible for the tested SHAs, not for unrun PR behavior.

findings.impact: Per-PR identity acceptance is incomplete even though merged-tree assertions passed.

evidence.location: pr301-pr303-premerge-enterprise-2026-10-24/OPERATOR_APPROVAL_QUEUE.md: rank 3; SESSION_SUMMARY.md: Pure pytest and What this does not prove
evidence.excerpt_or_summary: The submission explicitly says no ORM test for an undated vendor bill with header DueDate and its pure TradeDt test was not selected. Synthetic bill/incoterm tests and 48 pure cases do not close both paths.

findings.impact: Commercial data fidelity remains unproven for these two cases despite other passing ORM tests.

findings.title: Manifest version collision is not cleared by forced module upgrades

evidence.excerpt_or_summary: Both PRs advertise plasticos_transaction 19.0.2.3.40; combined local tree merges cleanly. All receipts upgraded entire 25-module roster; that forced -u path is not proof of Odoo.sh normal second-PR version-change detection. Queue says no edit required; this is not demonstrated.

findings.impact: A sequential merge may deploy new code without an Odoo.sh module upgrade if the manifest version stays unchanged. Version coordination remains an operator-gated integration question.

findings.title: Log contains non-failing missing filestore read tracebacks

evidence.excerpt_or_summary: M303 and BOTH transaction logs record FileNotFoundError under ir_attachment._file_read during TestSaleConfirmTransactionCreation.test_confirm_creates_transaction; Odoo returns 0 failed and 0 errors, so classification as a failed assertion is unsupported.

findings.impact: Flag log-quality/fixture completeness; do not reclassify as failing test without demonstrating a behavioral consequence.

findings.title: Formal combined module test was split across separate database clones

evidence.excerpt_or_summary: BOTH transaction suite ran in odoo_test_both_tx_10241950 while BOTH documents ran in odoo_test_both_docs_10241950. The pack requested one guarded multi-addon invocation against one clone; these are separate instances, although each runner upgrades the full roster.

findings.impact: The specific one-clone combined runtime acceptance gate was not met. Passing both subsets on the same Git SHA provides positive signal, not formal whole-system gate completion.
